diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service associates this project as a Shared VPC service project, but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. Every other resource in the module that operates on project-level services (shared_vpc_host, google_compute_project_metadata_item, google_project_service_identity, the default service account data sources) waits on the API-enablement resource via depends_on; this one could attempt the association before services like compute.googleapis.com are enabled, especially on a fresh project creation.
